name: Phantom Line Signal-Dampening Undersuit
description:
A full-body base layer designed to reduce the wearer's electromagnetic signature to near-zero. The fabric incorporates a fine metallic mesh that blocks RF emissions from augmentations, personal devices, and biological bioelectric fields. Wearing it is like wrapping yourself in a walking Faraday cage.

Used by individuals who need to move through electromagnetically surveilled environments without triggering sensors. The undersuit makes the wearer invisible to passive scanning — but also makes their augmentations unreachable from external systems, which can be both advantage and danger.
functionality: Full-body EM signature suppression, RF blocking, passive scan defeat
what_it_says: You don't exist on any electromagnetic spectrum and you're comfortable with the silence.
story_hooks: A Signal-Dampening Undersuit is found inside-out in a dumpster — worn reversed, the metallic mesh would amplify rather than dampen the wearer's EM signature, turning them into a walking beacon instead of a ghost.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting full-body undersuit that clings to the torso, limbs, and neck like a second skin. The surface has a subtle metallic sheen with a fine crosshatch pattern visible under light, giving it an almost mesh-like appearance. Worn beneath other garments, it creates an imperceptibly smooth silhouette with no bulk.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tight throughout — engineered to conform to the body without restricting movement. Stretches to accommodate most body types and augmentation profiles. Leaves the hands and feet exposed, with high neckline reaching to the jawline.
physical_description.primary_material: Conductive synthetic blend: base layer of moisture-wicking polymer interwoven with embedded copper-alloy micro-mesh at 0.1mm spacing. Lightweight ballistic-grade weave for durability.
physical_description.texture: Smooth to the touch with a subtle grid texture visible only under magnification. Cool against skin. The metallic mesh creates a faint rustling sound when flexed.
physical_description.color_scheme: Flat gunmetal grey with dark charcoal undertones. The embedded mesh creates a barely-visible geometric lattice pattern across the entire surface. No logos or branding — unmarked for discretion.
physical_description.closures: Seamless construction with friction-fit high neckline and integrated thumb loops at wrists. No visible zippers or snaps — designed to pull on over the head and stretch over limbs.
distinctive_features: Fine copper-alloy mesh visible under close inspection — the signal-dampening core
Seams reinforced with conductive thread to maintain Faraday cage integrity
Micro-perforations along the spine for temperature regulation without compromising shielding
Thumb loops prevent fabric from riding up during movement
No pockets or external attachment points — designed for invisibility
Discoloration patterns common where sweat degradation occurs over extended wear
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover — expensive enough to be corpo-accessible, but marketed to surveillance-conscious working-class operators and gray-market users
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by data runners, off-grid operatives, privacy activists, and anyone avoiding electromagnetic surveillance. Signals active counter-surveillance awareness and distrust of monitored infrastructure. Among street culture, it's a badge of someone operating in the margins.
physical_description.condition_typical: Starts pristine and unmarked. Over time shows sweat staining along the spine and underarms, micro-tears at stress points (shoulders, groin, elbows), and patina dulling on the mesh where skin contact is heaviest. Old units may have visible corrosion on the embedded mesh.

Shot from the side, showcasing the form-fitting silhouette and the faint geometric grid texture of the signal-dampening fabric. Model has visible augmentation ports at the neck and wrists, now shielded and dormant. Dark industrial warehouse backdrop with harsh blue-white neon rim lighting revealing the metallic sheen.
